description:
DEFECT (verified twice, 2026-08-31 at d5d45a074; reproduction assets in
scratchpad base/rev/protoB/protoC): transport-shape products for a
recursive group resolve by a schedule lottery, AND the anomaly is live at
base's NORMAL schedule -- predicate v4 ships return_layout lane(int|:none)
under analyzed value ty int|:first|:nil|:none (a lane strictly BELOW the
value's own type). Mechanism: whichever member's pull closes the knot
computes joined_transport_layout(WINNER's ty/demand, anchors-from-its-walk)
and finish_transport_shape_group (pull.rs:1609-1617) stamps that ONE value
on every member -- members wider than the winner get narrower-than-ty
lanes, narrower members get wider ones (one mechanism, both anomaly
signs; joined_transport_layout itself is order-insensitive). Under
pending.reverse() (jobs/runtime_demand.rs:3264): 11/214 take_drop and
76/221 predicate executables move (decomposed->boxed flips + ripple);
range_map 0; stdout byte-identical (boxed forms execute correctly). Also
measured: the pending-SCC UNDER-REPORTS real cycles (knots close with
members=1 at base), so group extent is itself schedule-dependent and
unequal "group-mates" already ship and run green -- nothing relies on
group-equal layouts.

## REFUTED MECHANISMS (both built as prototypes, do not rebuild)
- Boxed-Exact at the PENDING cut with the resolution arm neutralized:
  DEADLOCK (backend never settles; both sides park waiting on each other
  when neither is pending yet). The Recursive/group-finish path is the
  engine's cycle-breaking protocol, not bookkeeping.
- Per-member re-evaluation at the knot (cut_as_exact re-entry): LIVELOCK
  (12,400 knot re-entries on a 2-cycle) -- pending_dependency_reaches /
  pending_strong_component are queries over TRANSIENT scheduler state
  that the evaluation's own reads mutate; NO rule keyed on them can be
  entry-invariant.

## THE FIX (cold-reviewed plan): move the cut from scheduler state to FACTS
1. Structural recursion decided at RECIPE CONSTRUCTION
   (origin_transport_recipe, which holds facts): an in-SCC child (from the
   fz-kdt.13-arc call-graph facts) becomes TransportRecipe::Boxed { child,
   ty } with the child's ty resolved from facts
   (facts.analysis().value_types, transport.rs:1389-1395;
   world.activation_return for return positions) -- NEVER read as a
   product. NOTE: evaluate_transport_recipe threads the PARENT's ty into
   children (transport.rs:793-816), so the child ty must be carried in
   the recipe node, not derived at evaluation.
2. Evaluation becomes a pure DAG function of settled facts +
   out-of-cycle products: Alternatives joins Boxed like any Exact;
   Tuple keeps decomposition with lane(field_ty) for the boxed field.
   CARRIER SUBTLETY (reviewer): "boxed" for a lane is the lane's ValueRef
   REPR, not TransportCarrier::ValueRef -- forcing the carrier would
   regress base's carrier=Absent decomposed forms through the carrier-OR
   (transport.rs:812-824, 1682-1695). Boxed contributes carrier Absent.
3. DELETE the knot apparatus for transport shapes in the same motion
   (verified list): RecipeLayout::Recursive + anchor accumulation
   (transport.rs:784, 793-808, 812-816, 884-906), the resolution arm
   (:1572-1582), recursive_group_transport_layouts (pull.rs:1589-1607),
   finish_transport_shape_group (pull.rs:1609-1617), and the
   transport-side uses of pending_dependency_reaches /
   pending_recursive_group. The pull.rs group machinery STAYS for the
   CallableConstruction group (its own lottery = fz-kdt.96).

## RED-FIRST (no shims, no order perturbation needed)
Drive-altitude test on fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.fz:
no published return_layout lane-ty may be strictly below the position's
analyzed value ty (scope to full-value return demands; the
discarded-result zero-lane case at transport.rs:1500-1510 is legitimate
narrowing). RED at base on v4. Stays as the permanent anomaly-class gate.
pending.reverse() remains a documented MANUAL reproduction only.

## GATES
Q5 invariant test green; inventory pins 59/221/214; stdout byte-compare
both lanes; determinism pair; tools/canon-gate.sh diff reviewed
executable-by-executable -- expected movement is ONLY luck-dependent
executables landing on their precise forms; carriers must not move
Absent->ValueRef; lib+cli+matrix green; zero-uncaused unweakened.
Canon movement here is EXPECTED and pre-authorized (it is the bug's
corrected output).

## SEQUENCING
this -> re-apply scratchpad/fz-kdt.91.patch (then a pure permutation) ->
fz-kdt.80 Stage-1 dedupe (re-measured). fz-bfh.5 interaction reviewed:
the structural cut SHRINKS cone blast radius (product edge replaced by a
fact edge); no subscription hazard.
title: Transport recursion cut moves from scheduler state to facts: TransportRecipe::Boxed at in-SCC edges, per-position layouts, knot apparatus deleted
